title: CI / Runners
description: What every self-hosted GitHub Actions runner for BlackNBrownStudios is doing, what is waiting, and what just finished. Fed by apps/github-runner-exporter. Alerts are Sentinel's, not this dashboard's.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Runners executing a job right now.

targets.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runners_by_state{state="running"}))

panels.title: Idle
panels.description: Online runners with nothing to do.

targets.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runners_by_state{state="idle"}))

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Jobs queued for a runner across the watched repos. A self-hosted job waits instead of failing, so this is where a dead or full pool shows up.

targets.expr: count(max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_actions_job_waiting)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Offline / missing
panels.description: Registered runners that are offline, plus roster slots that never registered (ansible/inventory.yml says they should exist).

targets.expr: sum(max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runners_by_state{state=~"offline|missing"}))

panels.title: GitHub API
panels.description: Whether the exporter can read GitHub. 'no data' means the token is missing or rejected: the tables below are then empty because nothing could be read, not because nothing is running.

targets.expr: min(github_runner_exporter_api_ok)

panels.title: Machines: load on every host that runs CI
panels.description: One row per CI host: CPU busy now and averaged over 6h (the headroom a rebalance is judged on), 1-minute load against its cores, memory used, CPU package temperature, and how many of its runners are busy. '-' = that host exports no such series (macOS has no temperature sensor in node_exporter).

targets.expr: cc:host_cpu_busy_ratio and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
cc:host_cpu_busy_ratio:avg6h and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
cc:host_load1 and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
cc:host_cores and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
cc:host_mem_used_ratio and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
cc:host_temp_c and on (host) max by (host) (github_runner_pool_expected)
count by (host) (max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runner_state{state="running"}))

panels.title: Pools: busy, slots and queue
panels.description: One row per runner pool (cc:pool_* in prometheus-rules-command-center.yaml). A pool with every slot busy and jobs waiting, next to pools with idle slots, is where capacity should move. Queued runs GitHub never gave jobs are left out (they show in 'Waiting for a runner').

targets.expr: cc:pool_busy
cc:pool_slots
cc:pool_waiting
cc:pool_oldest_wait_seconds

panels.title: Runners: what is running where
panels.description: One row per runner. RUNNING rows show the job and how long it has been going; the 'last' columns show the last job it finished, which is what that runner is actually used for. Click a job to open it on GitHub. MISSING = a slot the roster expects that never registered.

targets.expr: max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runner_state)
max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runner_last_job) * 1000

panels.title: What each pool runs
panels.description: Workflows each runner pool finished recently (last ~60 completed runs per repo), newest first. Read from job history, so it stays true when the workflow files change.

targets.expr: max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_pool_workflow) * 1000

panels.title: Waiting for a runner
panels.description: Queued jobs, oldest first. 'needs' is the runs-on label set, so you can see which pool is short. '(run has no jobs)' is a run GitHub left queued with no jobs: it will never start, cancel it.

targets.expr: max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_actions_job_waiting)

panels.title: Recent runs
panels.description: The last completed runs per watched repo, newest first. Click the workflow to open the run.

targets.expr: max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_actions_run_recent) * 1000
max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_actions_run_recent_duration_seconds)
count by (pool) (max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_runner_state{state="running"}))
count by (repo) (max without (instance, pod, job, namespace, service, endpoint, container) (github_actions_job_waiting))
